scope: Unchanged released decoders (decodeFullAnnotator) of a transaction body of each era from Shelley to Conway at the era's decoder version (2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9): the pool metadata url of a registration in every era and the anchor url of a Conway DRep registration, a proposal and a vote, each written at the era's textSizeN bound and one byte over it; below version 9 also a 128-byte url and urls of two-byte characters at 64 and 66 bytes; no ledger rule, signature or script is run
referenceNode: 11.1.3 (matching embedded ledger package versions, not a bit-identical node release build)

baseTypes.note: textSizeN, textDecCBOR (644-668); instance DecCBOR Url and instance DecCBOR DnsName: textDecCBOR 128 from decoder version 9, textDecCBOR 64 below it (678-697)

sourceArchive.kind: repository tarball at the pinned commit

harness.image: scarab-conway-decoding:local (built as scarab-t3-conway-decoding:local), from scripts/oracle/conway-decoding/Dockerfile on scarab-plutus176-context-reference:local
